facts.text: AIR-v0-Data is registered with entry point isaac_env.air_env_data:AIREnvData
The project supports IsaacLab 2.0 and IsaacSim 4.5.0
The installation instructions require Isaac-Sim and then Isaac Lab
The action configuration has a joint-position term over the arm joints and a binary gripper term
ARM_JOINT defines six joints: shoulder_pan, shoulder_lift, elbow, wrist_1, wrist_2 and wrist_3
AIREnvBase.step takes a grasp pose and an optional policy inference criteria tensor
The simulation advances at 1/120 s per physics step with decimation 2, so one environment step is 1/60 s
The configured episode length is 5 s
STEP_TOTAL is 30 steps, the per-episode step total the timeout checks
The configured camera resolution is 480 x 640 and one camera is used
The observation groups are cam_pos and policy; the policy group holds rgb, normals, instance_segmentation_fast, distance_to_image_plane, pcd and gripper_pose
The reward is 1 when an object is lifted above LIFT_HEIGHT * 0.8 while the state machine is in lift

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 re-seeds the fake's Python random.Random and the kinematic update is deterministic, so one implementation repeats a trajectory for the same seed and actions; the upstream reset draws object poses with Isaac Lab's generators and the GPU physics was not run, so agreement with the upstream stream is not claimed

gaps: kinematic F0 stand-in: no Isaac Sim/PhysX rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, gravity, actuators, sensors, noise or rendering; each tick applies a small joint-target increment and nothing moves a real robot

the upstream AIREnvBase.step takes a grasp pose and loops until its policy inference criteria is met (air_env_base/env.py:276); the fake is a single-transition Gymnasium step that applies the seven action values as a kinematic target increment

the action space is a seven-value unbounded Box because the clone states no action bounds; the six arm joints come from ARM_JOINT (element_cfg.py:182-189) and the seventh value is the binary gripper action term (env_cfg.py:133-137), so the fake's increment gain is test data

the observation is reduced to two seven-value poses: the camera pose and the end-effector pose. NOT COVERED: the policy group's rgb, normals, instance_segmentation_fast, distance_to_image_plane and pcd image arrays, whose configured size is 480 x 640 per camera (element_cfg.py:63); the fake returns the two pose vectors only
the fake truncates after STEP_TOTAL 30 transitions (element_cfg.py:43) and never terminates on grasp success; its reward is a fixed 0.0 because no object, grasp or state-machine model exists
the upstream sim backend (gymnasium.make("AIR-v0-Data")) needs Isaac Sim 4.5 and Isaac Lab 2.0 (README.md:1, :55-57) and was not run; only the package fake backend was checked
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0 and clock lockstep; timestep_ms is the 1/60 s environment step (sim.dt 1/120 s with decimation 2, env_cfg.py:287-292)
snapshot and restore are not offered: neither the upstream environment nor the fake exposes get_state/set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step, reset or seed is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
